title: Hoffman at MIT studying under Marvin Minsky at the start of AI
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hoffman at MIT studying under Marvin Minsky at the start of AI, about early years of AI (unspecified) at MIT, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells his guest, a scientist named Hoffman who studies how the mind perceives the world, that he was at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology just as artificial intelligence was getting started. Michels says Hoffman studied under Marvin Minsky, one of the founders of the field, which frames Hoffman's ideas about perception and unseen intelligence as coming from the heart of that work.
